analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($88.65) vs SMA5/20/50 ($88.41/$94.00/$92.13): Mixed short-term and mid-term trend, above SMA5 but below SMA20/50.
· Position vs SMA100 ($91.31)/SMA200 ($82.91): Mid-to-long-term trend remains strong, above SMA200.
· 52-week position (71.2%) + Current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (40.2→42.2): Exited oversold territory and continues in neutral range, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.2732→-1.1209): Improving within negative territory, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $94.00): Sideways near the middle band, indicating lack of directional bias.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($88.30): Support confirmed based on SMA5 and Pivot S1 ($82.15).
· Swing Resistance ($92.14): Resistance confirmed based on SMA20 and Pivot R1 ($98.38), potential for upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Sideways pattern confirmed, no trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.52): Subdued volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing conviction in price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis: Assessed as an accumulation phase, maintaining a wait-and-see condition due to lack of clear directional bias.
